notes.title: 5Leaps free in 2023!
notes.content:
It was a long trip to make 5Leaps. To achieve that, my friend and partner Joel and I were working together for a year, designing all aspects, balancing each enemy and testing all the rounds until we got a good product.

Between our possibilities and limitations, we worked together to create a product with quality, where you can see our effort, emotions and a little bit of the best of us.

During the process, we had a lot of problems, with limitations with the game engine, and other infinite topics such as company creation, web creation, social network promotional videos, and a long etc. But we made up for our inexperience with effort until we achieved our goal.

My partner Joel insists Bennu was a wrong decision. From my perspective I think we can be proud to have the first commercial game made in Bennu, despite the fact that we miss a lot of useful tools. We have learned a bunch of things during the process and overall we are proud of our work.

To conclude, our lives have changed a lot since we published 5Leaps and our current situation is totally different, and we would like to offer the Steam community 5Leaps for free in 2023.

We hope you will enjoy it and if you like, write a little review, thanks.

David.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34823687/bb25c66f1979038b6a33ad1ef3e56a08a96b8d30.png[/img]

Hi [i]Rebel[/i]!
Approximately 1% of our [i]Rebels[/i] were having unwanted behavior in full screen. It is fixed!

This release solves the problem of incorrect viewing on screens with a high DPI configuration.

DDG and the [i]rebels[/i] of the community of Bennu (free video game development engine) have located and fixed the problem of DPI in a definitive way.

At the moment [b] there are no more known errors. [/b] If any [i] rebel [/i] has problems with the new version, please, contact us through our mail.
